items.item: Runs Apex tests with sf apex run test -o uat ... --result-format json (with --code-coverage) and says to read the JSON results
items.evidence: `sf apex run test -o uat --class-names OpportunityServiceTest --code-coverage --result-format json --wait 10 > test-result.json`; "Reading the results" section uses jq on test-result.json

items.item: Checks results with SOQL in the sandbox (sf data query -o uat)
items.evidence: `sf data query -o uat -q "SELECT Name, StageName, IsClosed, Partner_Discount__c FROM Opportunity WHERE Name LIKE 'ZZ_TEST PartnerDiscount%'"`

items.item: Names and cleans up any test records it creates, and never uses production or real customer data
items.evidence: Records named 'ZZ_TEST PartnerDiscount...'; step 8 deletes them and verifies `COUNT()` = 0; everything targets uat
